title: CMP-Compliance-Evaluator Input
description: Intercepted network requests and DOM HEAD fragment for compliance analysis.

dom_head.description: Raw HTML content of the page <head> element, including all <script> tags.

network_requests.description: Array of intercepted network requests from the browser session.

url.description: Full URL of the intercepted request.

geo.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or region tag indicating traffic origin (e.g. 'EU', 'US-CA', 'DE', 'FR'). Absence implies unknown jurisdiction.

response_headers.description: Optional map of HTTP response header names to values.
